change.title: Bind uncovered post-v0.8.4 production paths to the next source candidate
change.summary: Repairs the current-diff ChangeRecord coverage gap for eleven production paths already committed after v0.8.4 across provider compatibility, isolated acceptance seams, authority-writer fencing, and loopback retry hardening. This metadata-only carry-forward is introduced on a new candidate commit, does not backdate or publish a record for 112d4a99b6c68b2f3706a75b7567551fae5dc5eb, and changes no product behavior.

basis: the v0.8.4 peeled-base-to-candidate Git change set contains the eleven listed production paths

this new record is metadata-only carry-forward for a new exact source candidate and does not claim that the eleven historical source changes were introduced by this commit
artifact, installed runtime, live provider or Science or SSH, credentials, signing, notarization, and public release validation remain NOT-RUN
